finding: Browsing templates by category is impossible: the expanded gallery's category pills filter on a field every template contradicts, so 'Site Pages' — the category all ten belong to — returns an empty grid.

'My Templates' reads localStorage (:66-69) and is empty until someone uses the ⌘⇧P save command. Only 'All' lists anything. Once templateType is set the category pills are replaced by the type pills (TemplatesTab.tsx:450-493), so the only way back is the empty state's 'Show all templates'.
fix: The filter must compare the field the catalog actually populates. Note that no board draws these pills either — 807:7252 draws a different taxonomy (All / Landing / About / Contact / Blog / Portfolio / Pricing) — so the design owes a decision on what the categories are before the code can match it.
